verdict_reason: Mixed signal: cheap on smoothed 10yr earnings, pricier than what this stock has typically traded at over its own history. Present PE sits mid-band, not at either extreme.
devils_advocate: Shiller PE looks inflated mainly because FY080-081 EPS crashed to 7.64 (pe=52.2 that year, a provisioning/NPL hit), dragging the 10yr average earnings down and making today's 18.05 look cheap by comparison — that's a denominator artifact, not real value. Meanwhile the median-band read says the market is paying more than usual for GBBL right now, off a recent EPS rebound (23.21) that itself could be a bounce-back year rather than a new normal. Don't read cheap-vs-Shiller as a green light without checking whether FY082-083's EPS rebound is durable or a one-year recovery high.
